strings.name: Gael García Bernal
strings.summary: Bernal moved from Mexican screen work into international collaborations. Amores perros, Y tu mamá también and The Motorcycle Diaries explore youth, class and Latin American experience. He also directs and works with Diego Luna and other partners on Ambulante and film production, extending his public role into exhibition and creative exchange.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: The Motorcycle Diaries and documentary initiatives bring Latin American stories and emerging filmmakers into international exchange.
